name: Clone Home
text: Play: Make a token creature. If there are more friendly creatures than enemy creatures, archive Clone Home.

name: Chuff Ape
text:
Taunt.
Chuff Ape enters play stunned.
After Fight/After Reap: You may destroy another friendly creature. If you do, fully heal Chuff Ape.

name: Curse of Disappearances
text:
Treachery.
At the end of your turn, put a friendly creature into your opponent's archives. If that card leaves their archives, put it into its owner's hand instead.

name: Destructive Analysis
text: Play: Deal 2 Damage to a creature. You may purge any number of cards from your archives. Deal an additional 2 Damage to the same creature for each card purged this way.

name: Elite Disruptzord
text: Creatures more powerful than Elite Disruptzord cannot be played.

name: Extinction
text: Play: Destroy a creature and each creature that shares a trait with it. Gain 1 chain.

name: Grommid
text:
While Grommid is in play, you cannot play creatures.
After an enemy creature is destroyed fighting Grommid, your opponent
loses 1 Aember.

name: Grondal
text:
At the start of your turn, destroy the least powerful creature.
Play: Make 2 token creatures.

name: Hypnotic Command
text: Play: For each friendly Mars creature, choose an enemy creature to capture 1 Aember from its own side.

name: Invasion Portal
text: Action: Discard cards from the top of your deck until you discard a Mars creature or run out of cards. If you discard a Mars creature this way, put it into your hand.

name: Martian Hounds
text: Play: Choose a creature. For each damaged creature, give the chosen creature two +1 power counters.

name: Mass Abduction
text: Play: Put up to 3 damaged enemy creatures into your archives. If any of these creatures leave your archives, they are put into their owner's hand instead.

name: The Body Snatchers
text: Play: For the remainder of the turn, each enemy creature gains, "Destroyed: Fully heal this creature and give control of it to your opponent instead."

name: Total Recall
text: Play: For each friendly ready creature, gain 1 Aember. Return each friendly creature to your hand.

name: Urxym the "Diplomat"
text:
Elusive.
After Reap: Lose all your Aember. Destroy an enemy non-Mars creature for each Aember lost this way.

name: Yzphyz Knowdrone
text: Play: Archive a card. You may purge an archived card. If you do, stun a creature.

name: Blypyp
text: After Reap: The next Mars creature you play this turn enters play ready.

name: Crystal Hive
text: Action: For the remainder of the turn, gain 1 Aember after a creature reaps.

name: Deep Probe
text: Play: Choose a house. Reveal your opponent's hand. Discard each creature of that house revealed this way.

name: Ether Spider
text:
Ether Spider deals no damage when fighting.
Each Aember that would be added to your opponent's pool is captured by Ether Spider instead.

name: Genetic Vault
text:
At the end of your turn, you may put a card from your hand facedown under Genetic Vault.
Omni: Put each card under Genetic Vault into play as a token creature.

name: Memrox the Red
text:
Your opponent's cards cannot leave your archives.
Action: Gain 1 Aember for each card in your archives.

name: Psychic Network
text: Play: Steal 1 Aember for each friendly ready Mars creature.

name: Space Invaders
text: Play: Reveal any number of creatures from your hand. Make each creature revealed this way a token creature as if the card was on top of your deck.

name: Storm Crawler
text:
Storm Crawler only deals 1 Damage when fighting.
After an enemy creature reaps, stun it.

name: Uxlyx the Zookeeper
text:
Elusive.
After Reap: Put an enemy creature into your archives. If that creature leaves your archives, it is put into its owner's hand instead.

name: War of the Worlds
text: Play: Destroy all non-Mars creatures. Deal 2 Damage to each Mars creature.

name: Zorg
text:
Zorg enters play stunned.
Before Fight: Stun the creature Zorg fights and each of that creature's neighbors.

name: Brash Grabber
text:
If you are not haunted, Brash Grabber enters play enraged.
Omni: Move 1 Aember from an enemy creature to your pool.

name: Compliance
text: Play: A creature captures 1 Aember from its own side. For each Aember on that creature, make a token creature.

name: Dr. Xyloxxzlphrex
text:
Elusive.
After Reap: Play a Mars creature from your discard pile and ready it.

name: Mind Your Elders
text: Play: If there are more friendly Mars creatures than enemy Mars creatures, a friendly creature captures 3 Aember.

name: Mindwarper
text:
Elusive.
Action: An enemy creature captures 1 Aember from its own side.

name: Mk.2 Generator
text:
Mk.2 Generator enters play ready.
Action: Make a token creature.

name: Pyloyx Strr
text: Play/After Reap: Choose a player. Gain 1 Aember for each card in that player's archive. That player discards each of their archived cards.

name: Scoop Up
text: Play: Put a friendly non-Mars creature and an enemy non-Mars creature into your archives. If either card leaves your archives and you are not the owner of it, put it into its owner's hand instead.

name: Tyyryxn Delv
text:
Elusive.
At the end of your turn, you may put a creature from play facedown under Tyyryxn Delv.
After Reap: For each card under Tyyryxn Delv, make a token creature.

name: Vezyma Thinkdrone
text: After Reap: You may archive a friendly creature or artifact from play.

name: Xanotys Ploxx
text: After Reap: You may discard a non-Mars card from your hand. If you do, resolve the discarded card's bonus icons as if you had played it.

name: Xarn Trax
text:
Elusive.
After Reap: Move 1 Aember from a creature to your pool. If you do, deal 2 Damage that creature.

name: Researcher
text: Omni: Reveal a Mars card from your hand and archive it.

name: Aember Munch
text: After Fight: Your opponent loses 1 Aember.

name: Aberrant Warp Event
text: Play: Discard cards from the top of your deck until you discard a creature or run out of cards. If you discard a creature this way, put it into play and destroy one of its neighbors. Repeat the preceding effect on your opponent.

name: Big Magnet
text: Play: Choose a friendly creature. Take control of each upgrade in play and move it to that creature.

name: Borka Rikk
text: Each time a Mars card is discarded from your hand, make a token creature.

name: Entropic Manipulator
text: Play: Choose a player. You may redistribute the damage on the creatures that player controls among that player's creatures. (You may cause more damage to a creature than it has power.)

name: Ilxid Avenger
text:
Play/After Fight: Give Ilxid Avenger a +1 power counter for each Mars card in your discard pile.
Scrap: Give a friendly creature a +1 power counter for each Mars card in your discard pile.

name: Incubation Chamber
text: Omni: You may reveal a Mars creature from your hand. If you do, archive it.

name: Martian Revolution
text: Play: Destroy each friendly creature. For each creature destroyed this way, make a token creature.

name: Martians Make Bad Allies
text: Play: Reveal your hand. Purge each revealed non-Mars creature and gain 1 Aember for each card purged this way.

name: Mating Season
text: Play: Shuffle each Mars creature into its owner's deck. Each player gains 1 Aember for each creature shuffled into their deck this way.

name: Nautilixian
text:
Nautilixian cannot be used unless you have used 1 or more friendly Mars creatures this turn.
Each friendly Pilot creature cannot be dealt damage or destroyed.

name: Phylyx the Disintegrator
text:
Elusive.
Action: Your opponent loses 1 Aember for each other friendly Mars creature.

name: R-Evolution
text: This creature and each creature with the same name as it gain, "After Reap: Deal 2 Damage to an enemy creature."

name: Revo Hooligans
text:
Elusive.
After Reap: Put a paint counter on an artifact. While that artifact has a paint counter, it belongs to house Mars (instead of its other houses).

name: Shatter Storm
text: Play: Lose all your Aember. Then, your opponent loses triple the amount of Aember you lost this way.

name: Yxlyx Stimrager
text: After Fight: Deal 2 Damage to a creature and move it to either flank of its controller's battleline.

name: Agent Taengoo
text: Play: Choose a house. Return each creature of that house to its owner's hand.

name: Destroy Them All!
text: Play: Destroy an artifact, a creature, and an upgrade.

name: Exterminate! Exterminate!
text: Play: For each friendly Mars creature, destroy a non-Mars creature with lower power.

name: Ironyx Banner
text:
Each friendly Ironyx creature gets +1 power and +1 armor.
Play: Make a token creature.

name: Iyxrenu the Clever
text:
Elusive. Enhance Capture Capture Capture.
Action: Lose 1 Aember. If you do, move all Aember from a creature to your pool.

name: Nyyon Outpost
text: Action: Put a friendly creature on the bottom of its owner's deck. If you do, make 2 token creatures.

name: Nyzyk Resonator
text: For each neighbor Nyzyk Resonator has, your opponent's keys cost +2 Aember.

name: Red Planet Ray Gun
text: This creature gains, "After Reap: Choose a creature. Deal 1 Damage to that creature for each Mars creature in play."

name: Shark Bait
text: Play: Deal 2 Damage to a friendly non-Mars creature. If it is not destroyed, it captures 2 Aember.

name: Yipyax Abductor
text: Play/After Fight: Put an upgrade from play into your archives. If you are not the owner of that card and it leaves your archives, put it into its owner's hand instead.

name: Yxl the Iron Captain
text: Play: Each friendly Ironyx creature captures 2 Aember.

name: Zizok
text:
Skirmish. Splash-attack 1.
After an enemy creature is destroyed by Zizok's splash-attack damage, ready Zizok.

name: Exo Vanguard
text: After Fight: Capture 1 Aember.

name: For the Revolution!
text: Play: You may destroy a friendly non-Mars creature. If you do, make a token creature and ready that token creature.

name: Ironyx Propaganda
text: This creature gains, "After Fight/After Reap: Make a token creature."

name: Ironyx Rebel
text:
Deploy.
Play: Ready each of Ironyx Rebel's Mars neighbors.

name: Ironyx Vatminder
text: Play/Destroyed: Make a token creature.

name: Jynnux Boom
text: After Fight: You may discard a non-Mars creature. If you do, deal damage to an enemy creature equal to the discarded creature's power.

name: Mars First
text: Play: Ready and use a friendly Mars creature.

name: Mk.3 "Rookie"
text: After Fight/After Reap: Ready and enrage a neighboring Mars creature.

name: Myx, the Tallminded
text: Your opponent's keys cost +1 Aember for each friendly Mars creature in play.

name: Phlox 'em All!
text: Play: For each friendly Mars creature, deal 3 Damage to a creature.

name: Ulyq Megamouth
text: After Fight/After Reap: Use a friendly non-Mars creature.

name: Zutrinyx, the Innovator
text: Each friendly Mars creature gains splash-attack 2.

name: Green Aeronaut
text: Action: A friendly Nautilixian gains Splash-attack 3 for the remainder of the turn.

name: Purple Aeronaut
text: After 4 friendly Pilot creatures are used in the same turn, a friendly Nautilixian gains "After Fight: Destroy each enemy creature" for the remainder of that turn.

name: Red Aeronaut
text:
Play: Search your deck and discard pile for a Nautilixian and put it into play, then shuffle your deck.
Action: A friendly Nautilixian gets +5 power for the remainder of the turn.

name: White Aeronaut
text: Action: Ward and fully heal a friendly Nautilixian.

name: Minutemartian
text: After Fight: Make a token creature.

name: Rebel
text: After Reap: Deal 1 Damage to a creature.
